preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `clean_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Restore an ordinary-input combat chain in which mouse and gamepad fire commit complete authoritative shots, the player reaches Alpha through the intact authored map, and the preserved 3/5/10 roster produces autonomous, separated, event-driven encounters through A, B, and C.

diagnosis.root_cause: The weapon's authoritative shot implementation exists, but gameplay fire depends on an unhandled-input path that is vulnerable to shell, GUI-focus, mouse-capture, and analog-trigger dispatch; supported inputs therefore never reach the shot commit. Separately, the player follows a navigation-derived heading into blocking authored collision before Alpha, while activated enemies with no acquired target have no bounded patrol or scan displacement and legally settle at their home positions. These integration failures explain the simultaneous zero shot count, unreachable Alpha, and three active actors reporting idle, zero velocity, empty targets, full magazines, and no shot events.

stop_conditions: Stop and rework if clean boot, resource loading, the intact authored environment instance, or the preserved AK-74M/Saiga-12 viewmodel bindings regress.
Reject any fire repair that changes only ammunition, animation, audio, or HUD without one unique authoritative shot receipt and exactly-once hit or blocked result.

Do not solve route reachability by moving, extracting, hiding, or duplicating authored map children, adding a proxy floor, replacing the map, or repeating broad navigation/transform tuning; isolate collision and repair product-owned anchors or bindings.

Reject the encounter repair if an active living enemy remains without displacement, a search turn, cover change, or another legal action for more than five seconds, or if actors overlap, deadlock at doors, teleport, or fire without an aim window.
Stop this iteration after the two required gaps and the bounded Alpha-route repair; do not pull in deferred bomb-finale, settings-scale, pause/menu-back, product-shell redesign, or backlog work.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause strategy: make fire acceptance independent of fragile unhandled-event delivery, and isolate the actual player-capsule collision along the existing native route instead of rebaking navigation or retuning map transforms. Then bind active actors to explicit mission and target facts plus bounded targetless behavior, preserving the authored map, roster identities, viewmodels, HUD, and existing combat component.

code: Run the frozen clean-boot/import check and require no parse, missing-resource, signal-binding, or changed-resource load errors.

Exercise deterministic fire scheduler checks for mouse and trigger edges, SEMI/AUTO cadence, release, duplicate suppression, weapon switching, dry fire, reload, pause, death, checkpoint, and terminal cancellation.

Inspect route and AI state assertions for the native corner chain, player-capsule clearance, 18 unique IDs and slots, 3/5/10 regional counts, activation ordering, targetless watchdog actions, avoidance velocity consumption, and exactly-once enemy shot/death events.
runtime: Host/Tester should fresh-launch at 1280×720, deploy through the shell, and capture before, fire-peak, and recovery states separately for mouse and gamepad, aligning input source, shot ID, ammunition, ballistic result, feedback, and cancellation timelines.

Host/Tester should record one continuous ordinary-input run from spawn into Alpha and onward through A, B, and C, sampling player position/collision/overlap plus every active actor at early, middle, and contested moments without state injection.

Host/Tester should require complete player and enemy shot chains, visible AI state transitions, checkpoint commits, clean runtime/editor logs, stable restart behavior, and continued preservation of the intact authored map and 65-mesh baseline.
visual: Compare adjacent fire frames from the shipped first-person camera: the bound hands and weapon must show muzzle flash, recoil peak, recovery, real impact or target reaction, and synchronized reticle/ammunition changes without clipping or opaque debug overlays.

Capture first-person and overhead encounter views for Alpha and representative Bravo/Charlie moments; actors must occupy distinct depths and bearings, visibly move and telegraph aim, remain grounded, and avoid frozen poses, overlap, wall tracking, and doorway piles.

Preserve the visual reference's sparse grounded tactical hierarchy: cyan objectives, restrained yellow confirmation, red hostile/damage cues, readable world silhouettes, and a compact right-side kill row without broad cards obscuring the reticle or objective.

done_when: Mouse-left and gamepad right-trigger each submit an immediate authoritative shot after normal shell deployment; SEMI produces exactly one shot per press edge, AUTO repeats only at the equipped weapon rate, and release stops scheduling immediately.

Every accepted shot has one unique shot ID, decrements the equipped magazine once, resolves muzzle-origin ballistics as miss, blocked, or hit, commits damage at most once, and updates weapon state and HUD within two rendered frames.

The same shot ID drives viewmodel fire animation, muzzle flash, recoil and recovery, one weapon report, material-aware impact or target reaction, reticle state, and any hit or kill event; presentation listeners cannot create a shot or damage.

Reload, weapon switch, death, pause, defusal, checkpoint restore, and terminal state cancel held fire without a delayed or duplicate shot, and switching weapons preserves independent ammunition, rate, mode, and scheduling state.

Input telemetry identifies source, press or release edge, current shell/gameplay enable state, accepted or rejected reason, shot ID, magazine before and after, and cancellation reason without relying on debug labels in the shipped HUD.
tasks.instructions: Make the weapon controller the single authoritative owner of gameplay fire acceptance and repair the shell-to-gameplay handoff so mouse-left and the mapped gamepad trigger reach it after GUI focus and mouse-mode transitions. Use an edge-aware controller path that cannot be starved by unhandled-event ordering, while deduplicating any raw event and action-state observation. Preserve the existing SEMI/AUTO scheduler, AK-74M and Saiga-12 packages, ballistics, HUD family, and viewmodel. Route every accepted input through the existing exactly-once shot receipt and complete feedback fan-out, and add bounded telemetry needed to align input, shot, ammunition, result, feedback, and cancellation. Do not expand this task into the deferred pause/settings or product-shell redesign findings.
tasks.title: Restore authoritative mouse and gamepad fire

done_when: From a fresh normal deployment, ordinary movement follows a collision-clear native-map route into Alpha within 45 seconds without teleporting or state injection; Alpha overlap and capture progress become nonzero, and its checkpoint/key transition commits exactly once.

The route repair uses the intact authored environment and product-owned spawn, objective, collision, and route bindings; sustained collision at the previously observed approach position is gone and rendered ground, collision, and navigation remain aligned.

All three activated Alpha actors retain distinct identities and slots and show a target, purposeful patrol/search/scan, turn, or displacement within every five-second window; their velocities and nearest-neighbor distances demonstrate separation rather than transform-only motion.

An uninterrupted Alpha encounter exposes perception or search, locomotion, cover/flank or reposition intent, aim telegraph, authoritative fire and reload, hurt/stagger, lethal shutdown, death, and cleanup, with each enemy shot consuming ammo and carrying actor, weapon, muzzle, result, and event IDs.

Ordinary progression activates exactly 3 Alpha, 5 Bravo, and 10 Charlie identities in sequence without early inactive enemies, clone substitution, resurrection, capsule overlap, doorway deadlock, wall tracking, teleportation, or first-frame fire.

Early, middle, and contested snapshots expose actor ID, region, role, route target, action, velocity, safe navigation velocity, target visibility, fire-block reason, ammo, nearest-neighbor distance, avoidance state, presentation state, and last event for host and Tester recapture.
tasks.instructions: Repair the repeated Alpha progression blocker through collision isolation on the existing native route: trace the actual player capsule against the current navigation corner chain, then correct only product-owned spawn, route guidance, collision filtering, or objective bindings required for ordinary traversal. Do not perform another broad navigation rebuild or transform-tuning pass. In the same bounded encounter pass, explicitly bind roster actors to mission activation and valid player targeting, and add deterministic targetless patrol, scan, search, or cover-change behavior so an active actor cannot remain indefinitely idle at home. Once contact occurs, keep the reusable combat state machine authoritative for perception memory, safe navigation velocity, spacing, aim, fire, reload, damage, death, and animation presentation across the preserved 3/5/10 roster.
tasks.title: Make Alpha reachable and the full enemy roster autonomous
